The issuer exhibits a very strong credit profile, characterized by high profitability (EBIT margin of ~15.5%), a robust capital structure with low leverage (Total Liabilities to Total Assets of ~37.9% and a Solvency ratio of Assets/Liabilities above 2.6x), and excellent liquidity (Current Ratio of ~2.48x). With substantial retained earnings and strong asset protection, the company demonstrates exceptionally low default risk typical of a solid investment-grade rating.

DECISION: A+
